title: RaidhOS Boot Config
description: Schema for the boot.json file persisted by the RaidhOS UI / CLI and rendered into grub.cfg by raidhos-ui::grub::render_grub_cfg. All non-core fields are optional and additive — older configs continue to load.

defaultEntry.description: Path of the entry that should boot by default. Matched against BootEntryConfig.path (sanitised before emission to grub.cfg).

entries.description: Boot menu entries rendered in order (or grouped by class when tree_view is set).

grub_superuser.description: Ventoy gap G13. Non-empty value enables the GRUB superuser password gate. Sanitised to [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ before emission. Must be set together with grub_password_pbkdf2 for the gate to activate.

grub_password_pbkdf2.description: Ventoy gap G13. Output of `grub-mkpasswd-pbkdf2` (format: grub.pbkdf2.sha512.<rounds>.<salt-hex>.<hash-hex>). Plaintext passwords are rejected by `is_grub_pbkdf2_hash()` — the password-gate lines are only emitted when this string is a valid PBKDF2 hash.

tree_view.description: Ventoy gap G20. When true, entries with a non-empty `class` are grouped into `submenu "<class>" { … }` blocks. Classless entries float to the top level so power-user entries stay one keypress from boot.

title.description: Human-readable menu label. Sanitised against GRUB metachars before emission.

path.description: Path on the DATA partition. Dispatched by file extension: `.efi` → chainloader (G7); `.img` / `.raw` → loopback + chainload (loop) (G6); else → ISO 9660 kernel-search loopback flow.

params.description: Free-form kernel parameters appended to the linux line (sanitised).

initrd.description: Override the auto-detected initrd path. Empty string falls back to `(loop)/casper/initrd` (or live equivalent).

kargs.description: Additional kernel command-line args appended after `params`. Use this for autoinstall-style kargs (preseed, kickstart, autoinstall) until G12 is fully closed.

class.description: Ventoy gap G11. Emitted as `--class <value>` on the menuentry line; also used as the submenu label when `tree_view` is set (G20). Sanitised against GRUB metachars.

tip.description: Ventoy gap G11. Comment placed above the menuentry — typically a short hint shown to the user.

hidden.description: Ventoy gap G17. When true, the entry is skipped before sanitisation and never appears in the rendered grub.cfg (applies in both ListView and TreeView modes).

persistence_backend.description: Ventoy gap G18. Path of the per-ISO persistence backend file (e.g. `/persistence/ubuntu.dat`). When set, `persistent persistent-path=<value>` is appended to the linux line on the casper and live boot branches. Does not apply to .efi or .img / .raw paths.
